tools.name: fet112.network_state_attestation
tools.description: Attest observed native fetchhub-4 gas, transactions and blocks for the latest available finalized hour (four 15-minute windows). Signed coverage, source cursor, issue/expiry times and explicit fresh/stale/partial/unavailable observation status. No Ethereum data, native security verdict, anomaly asse

tools.name: fet112.verify_network_state_attestation
tools.description: Verify canonical signed payload, pinned identity, expiry and source age independently. No live chain canonicality check.

tools.name: fet112.network_state_keys
tools.description: Discover current Ed25519 public key and fingerprint. Discovery is not an independent trust anchor.

tools.name: fet112.analytics_catalog
tools.description: Discover supported native metrics, exact semantics, aggregations, coverage requirements and executable query examples. No model or chain RPC calls.

tools.name: fet112.analytics_query
tools.description: Execute a validated read-only native Fetch query: sums, extrema, weighted means, groupings, rollups and comparable UTC windows. Read analytics_catalog first. tools.name: fet112.transaction_comparison
tools.description: Compare native fetchhub-4 transactions TODAY and YESTERDAY over exactly the same elapsed UTC interval, ending at today's latest authoritative finalized cutoff. Both windows come from one SQLite snapshot. Returns counts, success rates, exact count difference and percentage change; unavailable coverag

tools.name: fet112.verify_quantitative_context
tools.description: Verify the separate native quantitative Ed25519 attestation and full consumer policy. Supply a trusted fingerprint to verify identity; does not evaluate chain canonicality, freshness or security.

tools.name: fet112.transaction_activity
tools.description: Native fetchhub-4 transactions included in blocks for today or yesterday UTC. Returns successful/failed/total counts, success percentage and average TPS over contiguous finalized 15-minute buckets. Empty periods with valid coverage have zero TPS and a NOT_APPLICABLE/null success percentage. Missing

tools.name: fet112.staking_context
tools.description: Observed native Fetch staking FLOW on fetchhub-4 for today or yesterday UTC, using finalized 15-minute buckets and comparable historical periods. Returns exact afet strings, coverage and source cursor. This is NOT total staked balance, a statistical anomaly assessment, or a security verdict. Signatu

tools.name: fet112.network_status
tools.description: Return FET112's current machine-facing network status. The verdict is copied from SecurityReportV1 for configured Fetch/ASI contracts on Ethereum (chain_id=1). Do not apply it to native fetchhub-4 traffic.

tools.name: fet112.recent_incidents
tools.description: Return bounded recent incidents associated with the current signed report context.

tools.name: fet112.security_report
tools.description: Return the current signed SecurityReportV1 for configured Fetch/ASI contracts on Ethereum (chain_id=1). It does not evaluate native fetchhub-4 traffic.

tools.name: fet112.pre_action_check
tools.description: Deterministic pre-flight over the current watched Ethereum security environment. V1 commits the intended action but does not classify destination, amount, asset, business authorization or simulate the transaction.

tools.name: fet112.verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify an arbitrary SecurityReportV1/attestation pair offline, optionally against a trusted FET112 key fingerprint.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "fet112.pre_action_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
